title: Online AC1024 sample compatibility: BLOCK_HEADER offsets and BLOCK_CONTROL holes
scope: Identify and inspect online AC1024-era sample candidates, bind their byte identity and independent reader evidence, and repair confirmed bounded compatibility gaps without adding drawing fixtures.

sources.title: Autodesk AutoCAD LT Sample Files
sources.evidence: Autodesk lists sample DWGs and says the sample set applies to AutoCAD LT 2010 and later.
sources.limitation: The page does not identify the saved DWG format version for each individual download.

sources.title: AutoCAD 2010 sample-file list and archive pointer
sources.evidence: The 2009 post identifies the listed files as AutoCAD 2010 samples and points to Autodesk's sample archive.
sources.limitation: Secondary historical source; it does not provide file hashes or verify that current archive bytes are unchanged.

downloadAudit.otherEndpoints: Several newer sample filenames listed on the LT archive returned HTTP 403; no bytes were retained for them.

independentWireEvidence.normativeSource: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §2.13: raw handle codes 0x6/0x8/0xA/0xC encode relative soft-pointer references; code 0x8 resolves to base handle minus one.

peer.name: LibreDWG
peer.jsonObservation: BLOCK_HEADER handle [0,1,2] has ownerhandle [8,0,0,1]; BLOCK_CONTROL handle is [0,1,1]. BLOCK_CONTROL has three null entries in its counted list and non-null model_space/paper_space phantom targets 0x2 and 0xC.

implementation.behavior: BLOCK_HEADER role validation now accepts DWG relative handle encodings 0x6, 0x8, 0xA and 0xC when the expected semantic role is soft pointer. For BLOCK_CONTROL, a null counted entry now emits one Warning and scanning continues; null model/paper-space phantom entries and non-null wrong-role members remain Error observations.

sampleRead.result: PASS: current libdxfrw reports operationSucceeded=true and legacyError=0, publishes all 498/498 observed frames, and has zero entity/object parse failures. At this first checkpoint, strict DXF output was still blocked by the BLOCK_CONTROL integrity error recorded below.
sampleRead.preFixDiagnostic: BLOCK_HEADER body handle role mismatch for blockControl: raw code 8 target 1

blockControlHoles.spec: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.51 separates counted BLOCK_HEADER references from the final *MODEL_SPACE and *PAPER_SPACE hard-owner references.
blockControlHoles.peerBehavior: LibreDWG 0.14 retains null counted entries and skips null entry pointers during table lookup; its model/paper-space references remain distinct.
blockControlHoles.policy: A null counted member is recoverable with a warning. Null model/paper-space phantom handles remain strict-fatal. The source's missing counted references do not become writer-closure or support evidence.
blockControlHoles.result: PASS: counted null member is a Warning, no integrity Errors remain, and all 498/498 frames publish. Strict output now reaches opaque callback finalization, then refuses at 106/109 qualified; the three unqualified records are SORTENTSTABLE handles 0x3398, 0x3668 and 0x3924. No output DXF is published.

implementation.generatedControl: PASS: libdxfrw_block_record_body_handle_roles covers all four ODA relative soft-pointer encodings and the existing wrong-role, truncation/reset and corrected-retry cases.

qualificationGate: Download only to a scratch location and record URL, retrieval date, byte length and SHA-256.
Verify the first six bytes are AC1024 before treating a file as an AC1024 sample.
Check hashes against the existing local corpus so aliases do not count as independent sources.
Run current fast read/strict-output probes and independent reader comparison on eligible candidates.
Do not commit downloaded DWG or derived DXF fixtures; create a local-from-scratch fixture only if a minimized regression is needed.
result: Autodesk's title_block-ansi sample is a new unique AC1024 source. It exposed both a relative soft-pointer role false rejection and null counted BLOCK_CONTROL entries. The parser now accepts the documented relative codes; it warns on counted BLOCK_CONTROL holes but preserves strict-fatal handling for required model/paper-space members. The sample reads 498/498 observed frames with zero entity/object parse failures. Strict DXF output now reaches and refuses the independent opaque-output gate at 106/109. Other retrieved samples either match existing AC1024 hashes or are AC1021. No drawing fixture was added to the repository.
